messages.subject: Shiny caching issue
parts:
I have made an app that prompts the user for a file and do some stuff with it.
It is hosted on shiny server, but I'm not the administrator.

It works everytime when run locally.
It works when run the first time in a browser, but then fails to work:
1) I can still browse for the file, but then nothing else happens
2) The UI does not render properly

I think it may be related to:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/jYx96xoVAWM

As it functions correctly the first time it is run from the server after an edit and save in rstudio server.

I use FlexDashBoard in Rmarkdown to create the app.
The data file is loaded using shiny::fileInput widget:

shiny::fileInput(inputId = "file", label = "Chose file", multiple = FALSE, accept = NULL, width = NULL,
  buttonLabel = "Browse...", placeholder = "No file selected")

The data is created using shiny::reactive

data_file <- shiny::reactive({

    if (is.null(input$file)){
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  inFile <- input$file
  path <- inFile$datapath
  
  df <- readr::read_tsv(path, locale = locale(decimal_mark = input$dec_sep))

... other stuff ...
})

What am I doing wrong? how can I clear the cache? 

Any help is appreciated...

/Jannik

messages.subject: Re: Shiny caching issue
parts:
Dear Joe

The app was developed using a flexdashboard and R-markdown.
I have stripped it down to a minimal example showing the issue (see below).
It works, every-time, when run from the console.
It only works the first time when run from shiny server.
In the first run on shiny server, Test will show NULL until a file is selected after which it will display the file contents.
If I update the page or turn to another browser, nothing is displayed in Test, and no file is loaded in my setup.
If I make a small change to the .rmd file, it works again, but only the first time.

Pls, let me know if you need more information.

I appreciate you help.

---
title: "ShinyRAPr"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(flexdashboard)
```

```{r reactives}
data_file <- shiny::reactive({
  
  inFile <- input$file
  
  if (is.null(inFile)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df <- readr::read_tsv(inFile$datapath)
  
  return(df)
})

```



Inputs {.sidebar}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}

multiple = FALSE,
                 accept = NULL,
                 width = NULL,
                 buttonLabel = "Browse...",
                 placeholder = "No file selected")
